# tools.zulqurnainj.com — SaaS Tools by Zulqurnain Haider

## What this subdomain is
A collection of self-hosted SaaS tools built by Zulqurnain Haider. All tools run on private infrastructure — your data stays private.

## Tools available

### Text To Leads Extractor
URL: https://tools.zulqurnainj.com/text-to-leads
Paste any job post, LinkedIn message, or outreach text. AI extracts recruiter emails, WhatsApp numbers, and Telegram handles — then generates a personalised message with your CV attached, sent in one click.
- Connects Gmail, Outlook, or Yahoo (send from your own address)
- AI contact extraction from raw text
- Auto-generated personalised email with CV attached
- One-click WhatsApp and Telegram links
- CV upload, stored and reused for every outreach
- Built with self-hosted AI (privacy-first)

### Prompt Health Checker
URL: https://tools.zulqurnainj.com/prompt-health-checker
Analyse and score your AI prompts for clarity, specificity, and effectiveness before sending them to any LLM. Get actionable improvement suggestions.

### NotePackz
URL: https://tools.zulqurnainj.com/notepackz
A minimal, privacy-first notepad with rich-text editing, public shareable links, and cloud sync.
- Rich-text editor (TipTap)
- Guest notes with no sign-up required
- Shareable public links and embed support
- ASCII table and Unicode tools
- Plans: Free (5 links), Pro, Lifetime
